forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 47 of November, teams completed 1 zone survey and 1 visit; no technical surveys or clearances were completed. There were 23 team-days worked and 17 lost to rain or wind. So far, 30 zones have been surveyed, 11 declared free, and 31 areas released.

For the current plan, P11, 12 zones are closed by the access feed. 0 teams stood down, 0 had no report for more than a week, 0 reports were held or queried, and 0 dossiers were held. No new plan was approved this week.

The forecast made in week 45, for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is already done, gives a range of 11 to 13 mine areas cleared this season and 10 to 11 zones declared free this season.
